answer: Commit first: hash the payload and post the hash. Reveal at epoch close: publish the payload, and the node checks the hash matches. Reject duplicates: the same payload hash cannot settle twice, and a second attempt forfeits the poster's bond. Draw auditors from a pool reseeded each epoch, so the same three reviewers cannot camp on one target. Then record it: one violet mark per forfeit, readable in the explorer. A farm of 500 keys must produce 500 distinct orchard payloads per epoch, and a nebula of cloned receipts collapses at the first reveal.
